description: Find current prices for a product on sharpest.ai: GPUs, CPUs, RAM, SSDs, phones, laptops, cameras, consoles, Pokemon and other trading cards, LEGO, and everyday staples priced per unit (batteries, coffee, cables...). Returns today's lowest and median US eBay Buy It Now asking price (item + shipping, USD; not sold prices) or, for staples, the cheapest price per unit across Amazon and eBay, with a link to the product page.

limit.description: How many rows to return (integer, default shown in the schema), e.g. 5

query.description: What to price, e.g. 'rtx 4090', 'aa batteries', 'canon r50'

name: search_prices
